testcase.name: while loading, the page shows the icon and the loading words, no Done, and the icon pulses
when done the icon stops pulsing, the words change, and Done is at its centre
a touch on the page outside the icon does nothing and does not reach the screen underneath
a touch on the icon while loading does nothing
with the system's animations off, the tap leaves at once
the icon is the button, with content description Done, a click action, and a touch target of at least 48 dp
real touches across the icon's own bounds all press it, not only one at its centre
the tap makes the icon grow and fade for about 300 ms, then the page is gone
